title: Prohibition on Use of Non-American AI Systems (Proposed — Refresh 32)
vector: GSAR, AI, Artificial Intelligence, American AI, National Security, Supply Chain
clause_text: PROPOSED CLAUSE (GSAR Refresh 32, not yet binding): This proposed GSAR clause would prohibit contractors from using AI systems developed or owned by entities of concern—including entities headquartered in, operating under the jurisdiction of, or substantially controlled by China, Russia, Iran, North Korea, Cuba, or Venezuela—in performance of any General Services Administration contract. 'AI system' means any machine-based system that makes decisions, recommendations, or predictions based on training data or algorithms. Contractors must attest at time of offer and upon request during performance that no prohibited AI systems are used. A prohibited AI system used in supply chain components or subcontractor performance is also covered. Violations would constitute a material breach and could trigger False Claims Act liability. Note: As of 2025, this clause is proposed under GSAR 552.239-7001 but is NOT yet enacted as binding law.
